build_sparse_conv_forward: build a sparse convolution forward pass using SparseConvFunction with features, filters, and indice pairs
build_inverse_conv_forward: build a sparse inverse convolution forward pass using SparseInverseConvFunction to upsample sparse features
build_subm_conv_forward: build a submanifold sparse convolution forward pass using SubMConvFunction for same-resolution sparse features
